The local open that declares x: the body before it, its target, the items up to and including x's, and x's item. An entry named x after the open shadows it.
Fixpoint gm_item_upto (Φ : gmod) (x : string) : option (gmod * modexp * list iitem * iitem) :=
  match Φ with
  | gm_nil => None
  | gm_ext Φ' y _ => if String.eqb x y then None else gm_item_upto Φ' x
  | gm_open Φ' H its =>
      match items_upto x its with
      | Some (its1, it) => Some (Φ', H, its1, it)
      | None => gm_item_upto Φ' x
      end
  end.

M applied to args, outermost first (apps_exp).
Abbreviation apps := apps_exp (only parsing).

The root of a module expression, its arguments, outermost first, and the chain of submodules selected. Arguments and selections commute, since members are closed over the parameters they lie under.
Fixpoint modexp_spine (H : modexp) : (modexp * list exp * list string)%type :=
  match H with
  | me_mem H y => let '(R, args, pre) := modexp_spine H in (R, args, pre ++ y :: nil)
  | me_app H N => let '(R, args, pre) := modexp_spine H in (R, args ++ N :: nil, pre)
  | _ => (H, nil, nil)
  end.

A module expression with no argument.
Fixpoint me_noargs (H : modexp) : Prop :=
  match H with
  | me_mem H _ => me_noargs H
  | me_app _ _ => False
  | _ => True
  end.

The Π a type is, looking through local definitions and local modules.
Fixpoint pi_view (A : typ) : option (typ * typ)%type :=
  match A with
  | a_pi B C => Some (B, C)
  | a_let (b_def B N) T =>
      match pi_view T with
      | Some (B', C') => Some (B'[Id,,N], C'[q (Id,,N)])
      | None => None
      end
  | a_let (b_mod U) T =>
      match pi_view T with
      | Some (B', C') => Some (B'[Id ,,ₘ me_lit U], C'[q (Id ,,ₘ me_lit U)])
      | None => None
      end
  | _ => None
  end.

The Πs a normal type is written with and what they end in: the domains as a context, innermost first (the last Π's domain at the head, the first one's at the end), and the codomain past them, in that context. Π (A : Typeω@0). A → Typeω@0 gives the context ce_ass #0 :: ce_ass Typeω@0 :: nil (the inner domain A, bound second, at the head) and the codomain Typeω@0.
Fixpoint nf_pi_tele (W : nf) : (ctx * nf)%type :=
  match W with
  | nf_pi B C => let '(Ds, C') := nf_pi_tele C in (Ds ++ ce_ass (nf_to_exp B) :: nil, C')
  | _ => (nil, W)
  end.

A normal type that is a universe, large or small.
Definition nf_is_universe (W : nf) : Prop :=
  match W with
  | nf_typ _ | nf_univ _ _ => True
  | _ => False
  end.

M applied to the n innermost variables, outermost first, past them: M, in Γ, read in Ds ++ Γ for an n-entry Ds, at the variables Ds binds.
Definition exp_applied_to_vars (M : exp) (n : nat) : exp := apps_exp M[wk_shiftn n]ʷ (vars_from 0 n).

Arities

A module's arity is the telescope of parameters it still takes, a ctx over the context of the module, innermost first. Its entries may include local definitions and modules, from the bodies around the module; they are not parameters, and an argument goes to the outermost assumption, through them.
tele_view T is that assumption's type and the rest of the telescope, over the context extended by it, the definitions and modules outside the assumption substituted away; None if T has no assumption left. It is computed outermost first, on the reversed telescope, as pi_view is on a type: through a definition, the view inside it is moved out by substituting the definition.
Fixpoint tele_open (R : list centry) : option (typ * ctx)%type :=
  match R with
  | nil => None
  | ce_ass B :: R' => Some (B, rev R')
  | ce_def B N :: R' =>
      match tele_open R' with
      | Some (B', T') => Some (B'[Id,,N], tele_sub T' (q (Id,,N)))
      | None => None
      end
  | ce_mod U :: R' =>
      match tele_open R' with
      | Some (B', T') => Some (B'[Id ,,ₘ me_lit U], tele_sub T' (q (Id ,,ₘ me_lit U)))
      | None => None
      end
  | ce_dm _ N U :: R' =>
      match tele_open R' with
      | Some (B', T') => Some (B'[Id ,,ᵈ N ‖ me_lit U], tele_sub T' (q (Id ,,ᵈ N ‖ me_lit U)))
      | None => None
      end
  end.

Definition tele_view (T : ctx) : option (typ * ctx)%type := tele_open (rev T).

The telescope left when the outermost parameter is instantiated with N: a module of arity T, applied to N, has arity tele_inst T N.
Definition tele_inst (T : ctx) (N : exp) : option ctx :=
  match tele_view T with
  | Some (_, T') => Some (tele_sub T' (Id,,N))
  | None => None
  end.

A module F (A : Typeω@0) (f : forall (x : A) -> A) takes ⋅ ▹ Typeω@0 ▹ Π #0 #1; applied to ℕ, it takes ⋅ ▹ Π ℕ ℕ.
Example tele_inst_example : tele_inst (⋅ ▹ Typeω@0 ▹ Π #0 #1) ℕ = Some (⋅ ▹ Π ℕ ℕ).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Descriptions

A description says what a module expression denotes (mdenote below): a term of a type with its δ-reduct, if it has one (mdesc_term); an open (local) module, its parameters, its body as written and the body read through the entries its local opens generate (mdesc_open Δ Φ Φx: the module is the written body, its entries are read in the expansion); a closed module, stored at its canonical path p closed over its full telescope T, given the arguments Ns and still abstracted over the parameters Θ that come from outside it (mdesc_closed Θ p T Φ Ns): the path is what identifies a filed module, two filed modules with equal bodies staying distinct; or a term part with a module part (mdesc_dm Θ A M Rm): a definition with a module part, or the type former of an inductive or a record type with its module (ind_former_desc, record_former_desc). The arguments are terms over the context extended by Θ. A description never contains an alias, and its entries are read where no local open is left.
A lookup returns the whole description, and each rule takes the part it expects: the term part (mdesc_type, mdesc_reduct), the module part (mdesc_mod).
The sort of a member, as evaluation reads it.
Inductive member_kind : Set :=
A definition
| member_kind_term
A module
| member_kind_mod
A member with a term part and a module part: an inductive type, a record type, or a definition with a module part
| member_kind_dm.

A member description: what a module expression or an entry denotes (see the section header above).
Inductive mdesc : Set :=
A term of the type, with its δ-reduct if it is transparent
| mdesc_term : typ -> option exp -> mdesc
An open body module: its parameters, its written body and its expansion
| mdesc_open : ctx -> gmod -> gmod -> mdesc
A closed module, at its canonical path, over its full telescope, given the arguments so far, abstracted over the outer parameters
| mdesc_closed : ctx -> qname -> ctx -> gmod -> list exp -> mdesc
mdesc_dm Θd A M Rm: what a definition with a module part (ge_def_mod) denotes, and the type former of an inductive or a record type with its module (ind_former_desc, record_former_desc). Its term part is read as a transparent definition's is: the term M of the type A, both over the outer parameters Θd, given the arguments so far as mdesc_term A (Some M) is (mdesc_ats_read); its module part is Rm
| mdesc_dm : ctx -> typ -> exp -> mdesc -> mdesc.

A description of a module, of either storage.
Definition mdesc_is_mod (R : mdesc) : Prop :=
  match R with
  | mdesc_open _ _ _ | mdesc_closed _ _ _ _ _ => True
  | _ => False
  end.

The description of a body module Φ, read as Φx through the entries its local opens generate, by its storage: an open one is its parameters, its body and the expansion; a closed one, stored at the path o it is read at, is given no argument yet. A closed body is a module only where it is stored: read anywhere else, it has no description.
Definition mdesc_body (o : option qname) (sm : smark) (Δ : ctx) (Φ Φx : gmod) : option mdesc :=
  match sm with
  | sm_open => Some (mdesc_open Δ Φ Φx)
  | sm_closed => option_map (fun pq => mdesc_closed nil pq Δ Φx nil) o
  end.

The term part: the type of a definition, or of a definition with a module part, over the outside parameters.
Definition mdesc_type (R : mdesc) : option typ :=
  match R with
  | mdesc_term A _ => Some A
  
A definition with a module part: its term part's type
  | mdesc_dm Θd A _ _ => Some (ctx_pi Θd A)
  | _ => None
  end.

The δ-reduct of the term part: the body of a transparent definition, or of a definition with a module part; an axiom and an abstract definition have none.
Definition mdesc_reduct (R : mdesc) : option exp :=
  match R with
  | mdesc_term _ om => om
  | mdesc_dm Θd _ M _ => Some (ctx_fn Θd M)
  | _ => None
  end.

The module part: a module is its own, and a definition with a module part's is that of its module part.
Fixpoint mdesc_mod (R : mdesc) : option mdesc :=
  match R with
  | mdesc_open _ _ _ | mdesc_closed _ _ _ _ _ => Some R
  
A definition with a module part: the module of its module part, so that a module part is always read as a module
  | mdesc_dm _ _ _ Rm => mdesc_mod Rm
  | mdesc_term _ _ => None
  end.

The telescope of parameters a module still takes: an open module's parameters; a closed one's outside parameters, then the rest of its telescope after the arguments given, instantiated by them.
Definition mdesc_tele (R : mdesc) : option ctx :=
  match R with
  | mdesc_open Δ _ _ => Some Δ
  | mdesc_closed Θ' _ T _ Ns =>
      if Nat.leb (List.length Ns) (List.length T)
      then Some (tele_sub (List.firstn (List.length T - List.length Ns) T) (sb_of_list Id Ns) ++ Θ')
      else None
  | _ => None
  end.

The telescope of the module part: what a module expression used as a module still takes.
Definition mdesc_mod_tele (R : mdesc) : option ctx :=
  match mdesc_mod R with
  | Some Rm => mdesc_tele Rm
  | None => None
  end.

Abstraction: a description from inside an open body, the body's parameters and the entries before the member being Θ', re-expressed outside it. Π and λ read a definition entry of Θ' as a let.
Fixpoint mdesc_up (Θ' : ctx) (R : mdesc) : mdesc :=
  match R with
  | mdesc_term A om => mdesc_term (ctx_pi Θ' A) (option_map (ctx_fn Θ') om)
  | mdesc_open Δ Φ Φx => mdesc_open (Δ ++ Θ') Φ Φx
  | mdesc_closed Θ p T Φ Ns => mdesc_closed (Θ ++ Θ') p T Φ Ns
  | mdesc_dm Θd A M Rm => mdesc_dm (Θd ++ Θ') A M (mdesc_up Θ' Rm)
  end.

The λ a term is, looking through local definitions and local modules as pi_view does.
Fixpoint fn_view (M : exp) : option exp :=
  match M with
  | a_fn _ M' => Some M'
  | a_let (b_def _ N) T =>
      match fn_view T with
      | Some M' => Some M'[q (Id,,N)]
      | None => None
      end
  | a_let (b_mod U) T =>
      match fn_view T with
      | Some M' => Some M'[q (Id ,,ₘ me_lit U)]
      | None => None
      end
  | _ => None
  end.

The outermost assumption of a telescope, given outermost first: its type, the telescope inside it, and the substitution taking what lives under the whole telescope to what lives under the assumption and the rest, the definitions and modules outside it substituted away (inl); or, when there is no assumption, the substitution removing all of them (inr). tele_open is its first two components.
Fixpoint tele_split (R : list centry) : ((typ * ctx * sub) + sub)%type :=
  match R with
  | nil => inr Id
  | ce_ass B :: R' => inl (B, rev R', Id)
  | ce_def B N :: R' =>
      match tele_split R' with
      | inl (B', T', τ) => inl (B'[Id,,N], tele_sub T' (q (Id,,N)), τ ⨟ sb_qn (S (List.length T')) (Id,,N))
      | inr τ => inr (τ ⨟ (Id,,N))
      end
  | ce_mod U :: R' =>
      match tele_split R' with
      | inl (B', T', τ) => inl (B'[Id ,,ₘ me_lit U], tele_sub T' (q (Id ,,ₘ me_lit U)), τ ⨟ sb_qn (S (List.length T')) (Id ,,ₘ me_lit U))
      | inr τ => inr (τ ⨟ (Id ,,ₘ me_lit U))
      end
  | ce_dm _ N U :: R' =>
      match tele_split R' with
      | inl (B', T', τ) => inl (B'[Id ,,ᵈ N ‖ me_lit U], tele_sub T' (q (Id ,,ᵈ N ‖ me_lit U)),
                                τ ⨟ sb_qn (S (List.length T')) (Id ,,ᵈ N ‖ me_lit U))
      | inr τ => inr (τ ⨟ (Id ,,ᵈ N ‖ me_lit U))
      end
  end.

Application "R at N": N is the next parameter. A leading definition entry is substituted away first, in every form. An open module substitutes N into its body; a closed one with outside parameters left fills the outermost of them, and with none records the argument, the stored module being read as it is; likewise for an inductive type. A definition with a module part given its outside parameters fills them, in both its parts, as a closed module does; past them it is its module part applied: the term reading and the module reading of K N are separate, and an application is a module reading. (Its term part takes only the arguments of the frames it is filed in, when it is read as a member of a closed module at them: mdesc_read.)
Fixpoint mdesc_at (R : mdesc) (N : exp) : option mdesc :=
  match R with
  | mdesc_term A om =>
      match pi_view A with
      | Some (_, C) =>
          match om with
          | None => Some (mdesc_term C[Id,,N] None)
          | Some M =>
              match fn_view M with
              | Some M' => Some (mdesc_term C[Id,,N] (Some M'[Id,,N]))
              | None => None
              end
          end
      | None => None
      end
  | mdesc_open Δ Φ Φx =>
      match tele_split (rev Δ) with
      | inl (_, Δ', τ) =>
          Some (mdesc_open (tele_sub Δ' (Id,,N)) (gmod_sub Φ (τ ⨟ sb_qn (List.length Δ') (Id,,N)))
                  (gmod_sub Φx (τ ⨟ sb_qn (List.length Δ') (Id,,N))))
      | inr _ => None
      end
  | mdesc_closed Θ p T Φ Ns =>
      match tele_split (rev Θ) with
      | inl (_, Θ', τ) =>
          Some (mdesc_closed (tele_sub Θ' (Id,,N)) p T Φ (List.map (fun M => M[τ ⨟ sb_qn (List.length Θ') (Id,,N)]) Ns))
      | inr τ => Some (mdesc_closed nil p T Φ (List.map (fun M => M[τ]) Ns ++ N :: nil))
      end
  | mdesc_dm Θ A M Rm =>
      match mdesc_at Rm N with
      | None => None
      | Some Rm' =>
          match tele_split (rev Θ) with
          | inl (_, Θ', τ) =>
              Some (mdesc_dm (tele_sub Θ' (Id,,N)) A[τ ⨟ sb_qn (List.length Θ') (Id,,N)] M[τ ⨟ sb_qn (List.length Θ') (Id,,N)] Rm')
          | inr _ => Some Rm'
          end
      end
  end.

"R at N₁ … Nₖ".
Fixpoint mdesc_ats (R : mdesc) (Ns : list exp) : option mdesc :=
  match Ns with
  | nil => Some R
  | N :: Ns' =>
      match mdesc_at R N with
      | Some R' => mdesc_ats R' Ns'
      | None => None
      end
  end.

How a member of a module description is read once its entry's description is known (mdesc_read).
Inductive reader : Set :=
| reader_open : ctx -> gmod -> reader
| reader_closed : ctx -> list exp -> exp -> reader.

A description under a substitution. The parts of a description over the context are substituted; a closed module's stored unit is not, being closed.
Fixpoint mdesc_sub (R : mdesc) (σ : sub) : mdesc :=
  match R with
  | mdesc_term A om => mdesc_term A[σ] (option_map (fun M => M[σ]) om)
  | mdesc_open Δ Φ Φx => mdesc_open (tele_sub Δ σ) (gmod_sub Φ (sb_qn (List.length Δ) σ)) (gmod_sub Φx (sb_qn (List.length Δ) σ))
  | mdesc_closed Θ p T Φ Ns => mdesc_closed (tele_sub Θ σ) p T Φ (List.map (fun M => M[sb_qn (List.length Θ) σ]) Ns)
  | mdesc_dm Θd A M Rm => mdesc_dm (tele_sub Θd σ) A[sb_qn (List.length Θd) σ] M[sb_qn (List.length Θd) σ] (mdesc_sub Rm σ)
  end.

The entries of a local body before a member, filled in: the substitution sending each of them to its value, a definition to its body, a module to its unit and a definition with a module part to both, the entries before it filled in. An entry with no value (a definition without a body) cannot be filled in.
Fixpoint gm_fill (Φ : gmod) : option sub :=
  match Φ with
  | gm_nil => Some Id
  | gm_ext Φ' _ (ge_def _ _ _ (Some M)) => option_map (fun σ => σ ,, M[σ]) (gm_fill Φ')
  | gm_ext Φ' _ (ge_mod _ U) => option_map (fun σ => σ ,,ₘ me_lit U[σ]ᵘ) (gm_fill Φ')
  | gm_ext Φ' _ (ge_def_mod _ _ M U) => option_map (fun σ => σ ,,ᵈ M[σ] ‖ me_lit U[σ]ᵘ) (gm_fill Φ')
  | _ => None
  end.

A term with no δ-reduct read as the name M: a filed axiom or abstract definition δ-reduces to its own name.
Definition mdesc_self (M : exp) (R : mdesc) : mdesc :=
  match R with
  | mdesc_term A None => mdesc_term A (Some M)
  | _ => R
  end.

A term of a closed body read at the outside parameters Θ and the arguments Ns, as the name M there: with an outside parameter or an argument, one with no δ-reduct δ-reduces to its name; read bare, at neither, it is its own name already, and has no δ-reduct.
Definition mdesc_named (Θ : ctx) (Ns : list exp) (M : exp) (R : mdesc) : mdesc :=
  match Θ, Ns with
  | nil, nil => R
  | _, _ => mdesc_self M R
  end.
It is read through its lemmas, not unfolded.
Arguments mdesc_named : simpl never.

Lemma mdesc_named_nil : forall M R, mdesc_named nil nil M R = R.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

It reads only whether there are outside parameters or arguments.
Lemma mdesc_named_length : forall Θ Θ' Ns Ns', List.length Θ' = List.length Θ -> List.length Ns' = List.length Ns ->
    mdesc_named Θ' Ns' = mdesc_named Θ Ns.
Proof. intros [|] [|] [|] [|]; cbn; intros; first [ reflexivity | discriminate ]. Qed.

It is the description or its mdesc_self.
Lemma mdesc_named_cases : forall (P : mdesc -> Prop) Θ Ns M R, P R -> P (mdesc_self M R) -> P (mdesc_named Θ Ns M R).
Proof. intros P [|] [|] * H1 H2; exact H1 + exact H2. Qed.

What mdesc_self leaves as it is, it leaves as it is.
Lemma mdesc_named_fix : forall Θ Ns M R, mdesc_self M R = R -> mdesc_named Θ Ns M R = R.
Proof. intros [|] [|] * H; cbn; first [ reflexivity | exact H ]. Qed.

A term of no δ-reduct is read bare as itself, and otherwise as its name.
Lemma mdesc_named_term_none : forall Θ Ns M A,
    (mdesc_named Θ Ns M (mdesc_term A None) = mdesc_term A None /\ Θ = nil /\ Ns = nil) \/
    mdesc_named Θ Ns M (mdesc_term A None) = mdesc_term A (Some M).
Proof. intros [|] [|] *; cbn; auto. Qed.

Read at an outside parameter or an argument, it is mdesc_self.
Lemma mdesc_named_self : forall Θ Ns, (Θ <> nil \/ Ns <> nil) -> mdesc_named Θ Ns = mdesc_self.
Proof. intros [|] [|] H; cbn; try reflexivity; destruct H as [H | H]; contradiction H; reflexivity. Qed.

Whether a term is a type former, an inductive's or a record's, applied.
Fixpoint app_const (M : exp) : bool :=
  match M with
  | a_ind _ _ | a_record _ => true
  | a_app M _ => app_const M
  | _ => false
  end.

The term part of a description given the argument N: by β when its body is a λ, as mdesc_at; a type former applied, applied to N (see mdesc_ats_read).
Definition mdesc_term_part_at (R : mdesc) (N : exp) : option mdesc :=
  match R with
  | mdesc_term A (Some M) =>
      match pi_view A with
      | Some (_, C) =>
          match fn_view M with
          | Some M' => Some (mdesc_term C[Id,,N] (Some M'[Id,,N]))
          | None => if app_const M then Some (mdesc_term C[Id,,N] (Some (a_app M N))) else None
          end
      | None => None
      end
  | _ => mdesc_at R N
  end.

mdesc_term_part_at at N₁ … Nₖ.
Fixpoint mdesc_term_part_ats (R : mdesc) (Ns : list exp) : option mdesc :=
  match Ns with
  | nil => Some R
  | N :: Ns' =>
      match mdesc_term_part_at R N with
      | Some R' => mdesc_term_part_ats R' Ns'
      | None => None
      end
  end.

An entry's description given the arguments of the closed module it is a member of, which are those of the frames it is filed in: as applied (mdesc_ats), but a definition with a module part, or a type former, with no outside parameter is given them in both its parts: its term part as a transparent definition is (mdesc_term A (Some M)), its module part as a module is. So F 3 .K, for a def-mod K filed in module F (n : ℕ), is K's term at 3 as well as its module at 3; an application K N as a module, past the frames' arguments, is its module part only (mdesc_at).
The term part is given each argument by mdesc_term_part_at: as mdesc_at does, by β, when its body is a λ, and otherwise, when its body is a type former applied (app_const), by applying it to the argument. The second step is stable: it runs only at a filed entry's frame arguments, where the entry's coherence (gm_coh) makes a definition's body a ctx_fn over the frames' parameters, and where a type former's term part (ind_former_desc, record_former_desc) is the closed constant a_ind pq k or a_record p, applied: no substitution makes it a λ (app_const is kept by substitution). So F 3 .K is K's body at 3, and P ℕ .N, for an inductive N filed in module P (A : Type@0), is N ℕ.
Definition mdesc_ats_read (R : mdesc) (Ns : list exp) : option mdesc :=
  match R with
  | mdesc_dm nil A M Rm =>
      match mdesc_term_part_ats (mdesc_term A (Some M)) Ns, mdesc_ats Rm Ns with
      | Some (mdesc_term B (Some M')), Some Rm' => Some (mdesc_dm nil B M' Rm')
      | _, _ => None
      end
  | _ => mdesc_ats R Ns
  end.

H : (the [mdesc_dm nil] case of [mdesc_ats_read]) = Some R: R is a mdesc_dm nil of the two parts given the arguments.
Ltac mdesc_dm_read_shape H :=
  match type of H with
  | context [mdesc_term_part_ats ?R ?Ns] => destruct (mdesc_term_part_ats R Ns) as [[? [?|] | | |] |]; cbn in H; try discriminate H
  end;
  match type of H with
  | context [mdesc_ats ?R ?Ns] => destruct (mdesc_ats R Ns); cbn in H; [ injection H as <- | discriminate H ]
  end.

mdesc_ats_read is mdesc_ats, but on a definition with a module part and no outside parameter, given the arguments in both its parts.
Lemma mdesc_ats_read_inv : forall R Ns R', mdesc_ats_read R Ns = Some R' ->
    mdesc_ats R Ns = Some R' \/
    exists A M Rm B M' Rm', R = mdesc_dm nil A M Rm /\ R' = mdesc_dm nil B M' Rm' /\
      mdesc_term_part_ats (mdesc_term A (Some M)) Ns = Some (mdesc_term B (Some M')) /\ mdesc_ats Rm Ns = Some Rm'.
Proof.
  intros [| | | [| e Θd] A M Rm] Ns R' Ha; cbn [mdesc_ats_read] in Ha; try (left; exact Ha).
  right; destruct (mdesc_term_part_ats (mdesc_term A (Some M)) Ns) as [[B [M' |] | | |] |] eqn:Et; try discriminate.
  destruct (mdesc_ats Rm Ns) as [Rm' |] eqn:E; [| discriminate ]; injection Ha as <-.
  do 6 eexists; split; [ reflexivity | split; [ reflexivity | split; [ exact Et | exact E ] ] ].
Qed.

At no argument, mdesc_ats_read reads the description as it is.
Lemma mdesc_ats_read_nil : forall R, mdesc_ats_read R nil = Some R.
Proof. intros [| | | [| e Θd] A M Rm]; reflexivity. Qed.

On anything but a definition with a module part, mdesc_ats_read is mdesc_ats.
Lemma mdesc_ats_read_other : forall R Ns, (forall Θd A M Rm, R <> mdesc_dm Θd A M Rm) -> mdesc_ats_read R Ns = mdesc_ats R Ns.
Proof. intros [| | | Θd A M Rm] Ns Hn; try reflexivity; exfalso; eapply Hn; reflexivity. Qed.

On a module, mdesc_ats_read is mdesc_ats.
Lemma mdesc_ats_read_mod : forall R Ns, mdesc_is_mod R -> mdesc_ats_read R Ns = mdesc_ats R Ns.
Proof. intros [| | |] Ns Hm; cbn in Hm; first [ contradiction | reflexivity ]. Qed.

How an entry's description is read: one of an open body, the entries before it Φ' filled in, abstracted over the body's parameters Δ; one of a closed body, given the arguments recorded (mdesc_ats_read), a term with no δ-reduct being its name M there (mdesc_named), then abstracted over the outside parameters.
Definition mdesc_read (rd : reader) (R : mdesc) : option mdesc :=
  match rd with
  | reader_open Δ Φ' => option_map (fun σ => mdesc_up Δ (mdesc_sub R σ)) (gm_fill Φ')
  | reader_closed Θ Ns M => option_map (fun R1 => mdesc_up Θ (mdesc_named Θ Ns M R1)) (mdesc_ats_read R Ns)
  end.

A term read as a name is a term.
Lemma mdesc_named_term : forall Θ Ns M A om, exists om', mdesc_named Θ Ns M (mdesc_term A om) = mdesc_term A om'.
Proof. intros [|] [|] * ; destruct om; cbn; eexists; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma mdesc_mod_named_term : forall Δ Θ Ns M A om, mdesc_mod (mdesc_up Δ (mdesc_named Θ Ns M (mdesc_term A om))) = None.
Proof. intros; destruct (mdesc_named_term Θ Ns M A om) as [om' ->]; reflexivity. Qed.

A stored closed entry read in a closed body of telescope T: as it is, except that a closed submodule, stored with its own parameters only, is read with its full telescope.
Definition ge_read (T : ctx) (E : gentry) : gentry :=
  match E with
  | ge_mod pv (gu_mk Δ (md_body sm_closed Φ)) => ge_mod pv (gu_mk (Δ ++ T) (md_body sm_closed Φ))
  | _ => E
  end.

entry R y: the entry y of the module described by R, the context it is read in (over the module's context) and how its description is read; None for a term, or when R has no entry y.
Definition mdesc_entry (R : mdesc) (y : string) : option (ctx * gentry * reader) :=
  match R with
  | mdesc_open Δ _ Φx =>
      match gm_prefix_upto Φx y with
      | Some (gm_ext Φ' _ E) =>
          match E with
          
Inductive types are global: an inductive entry of a local body is not read. A transparent local definition is read, and so is a local definition with a module part; an abstract definition, and one without a body, are not: they are used only inside the body, as its definitions there.
          | ge_ind _ _ _ _ _ | ge_record _ _ _ _ | ge_def _ _ _ None | ge_def false _ _ _ => None
          | _ => Some (body_ctx Φ' ++ Δ, E, reader_open Δ Φ')
          end
      | _ => None
      end
  | mdesc_closed Θ p T Φ Ns =>
      match gm_prefix_upto Φ y with
      | Some (gm_ext _ _ E) => Some (nil, ge_read T E, reader_closed Θ Ns (apps (a_mem (qname_mod p) y) Ns))
      | _ => None
      end
  | _ => None
  end.

The unit a module description stands for, ⌜R⌝: a local body is its literal as written; a closed module with no outside parameter is the filed module at its arguments, and with outside parameters the alias of it over them. Anything else is no module, and stands for the empty body.
Definition mdesc_unit (R : mdesc) : modexp :=
  match R with
  | mdesc_open Δ Φ _ => me_lit (gu_mk Δ (md_body sm_open Φ))
  | mdesc_closed nil p _ _ Ns => me_apps (qname_mod p) Ns
  | mdesc_closed Θ' p _ _ Ns => me_lit (gu_mk Θ' (md_alias (me_apps (qname_mod p) Ns)))
  | _ => me_lit (gu_mk nil (md_body sm_open gm_nil))
  end.

The path an entry of a module is stored at: that of a closed module's entries; a local entry has none.
Definition mdesc_entry_path (R : mdesc) (y : string) : option qname :=
  match R with
  | mdesc_closed _ p _ _ _ => Some (qname_in p y)
  | _ => None
  end.

The type former of member k of the group D declared at pq, of its type, with the module part Rm; read at the frames' arguments (mdesc_ats_read), it is the type former at them.
Definition ind_former_desc (pq : qname) (k : nat) (D : ind_decl) (Mk : imember) (Rm : mdesc) : mdesc :=
  mdesc_dm nil (ctx_pi (im_params D Mk) (exp_wk (ind_sort D) (wk_shiftn (im_nn Mk)))) (a_ind pq k) Rm.

The type former of the record type R declared at p, of its type, with the module part Rm.
Definition record_former_desc (p : qname) (R : record_decl) (Rm : mdesc) : mdesc :=
  mdesc_dm nil (ctx_pi (record_params R) (record_sort R)) (a_record p) Rm.

The stored unit a path P names when it is a loaded unit or an open frame, with its full telescope: an open frame's own parameters, then those of the frames outside it. The open frame of the module of a member of a group, or of a record type, is not one: its path names the member (mdenote_ind_frame) or the record type (mdenote_record_frame).
Definition gc_unit (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (H : modexp) : option (ctx * gmod) :=
  match mod_qname H with
  | Some mp =>
      match gs_find_tele Ξ mp with
      | Some (U, nil, T0) =>
          match U, gs_find_ind Ξ mp, gs_find_record Ξ mp with
          | gu_mk Δ (md_body sm_closed Φ), None, None => Some (Δ ++ T0, Φ)
          | _, _, _ => None
          end
      | Some _ => None
      | None =>
          match q_chain mp, gds_lookup Θ (q_unit mp) with
          | nil, Some (gu_mk Δ (md_body sm_closed Φ)) => Some (Δ, Φ)
          | _, _ => None
          end
      end
  | None => None
  end.

A name an open declares is found by one lookup only.
Lemma items_upto_none : forall x its, existsb (String.eqb x) (map iitem_name its) = false -> items_upto x its = None.
Proof.
  induction its as [| it its IH]; intros H; cbn in *; [ reflexivity |].
  apply Bool.orb_false_iff in H as [H1 H2]; rewrite IH by assumption; rewrite H1; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma items_upto_some : forall x its r, items_upto x its = Some r -> existsb (String.eqb x) (map iitem_name its) = true.
Proof.
  induction its as [| it its IH]; intros r H; cbn in *; [ discriminate |].
  destruct (items_upto x its) eqn:E; [ rewrite (IH _ eq_refl); apply Bool.orb_true_r |].
  destruct (String.eqb x (iitem_name it)); [ reflexivity | discriminate ].
Qed.

Lemma gm_prefix_item_excl : forall Φ x Φ1, gm_prefix_upto Φ x = Some Φ1 -> gm_item_upto Φ x = None.
Proof.
  induction Φ as [| Φ IH y E | Φ IH H its]; intros * Hp; cbn in *; [ discriminate | |].
  - destruct (String.eqb x y); [ reflexivity | eauto ].
  - destruct (existsb _ _) eqn:Ee; [ discriminate |].
    rewrite (items_upto_none _ _ Ee); eauto.
Qed.

A body's entry named x and a name an open of the body declares for x exclude each other.
Ltac prefix_item_excl :=
  match goal with
  | Hp : gm_prefix_upto ?Φ ?x = Some _, Hi : gm_item_upto ?Φ ?x = Some _ |- _ =>
      rewrite (gm_prefix_item_excl _ _ _ Hp) in Hi; discriminate Hi
  end.

A path through an alias names no definition, and a path naming a module names no definition.
Lemma gm_submodule_resolve : forall Φ T x ip r,
    gm_submodule T Φ x ip = Some r -> gm_resolve Φ (x :: ip) = None.
Proof.
  fix IH 1; intros [| Φ y E | Φ c] * H; cbn in H |- *; try discriminate; [| eapply IH; exact H ].
  destruct (String.eqb x y); [| eapply IH; exact H ].
  destruct E as [b pv A B | ? [Δ [? Φ' | E']] | ? ? ? D Φ' | ? Aa Ma [Δa [? Φa | Ea]] | ? Rr Φ']; try discriminate.
  - destruct ip as [| z ip']; [ reflexivity |].
    eapply IH; exact H.
  - destruct ip; reflexivity.
  - destruct ip as [| z ip']; [ reflexivity |].
    eapply IH; exact H.
  - destruct ip; reflexivity.
  - destruct ip as [| z ip']; [ reflexivity |].
    eapply IH; exact H.
Qed.

Lemma gc_module_resolve : forall Θ Ξ p r,
    gc_module Θ Ξ p = Some r -> gc_resolve Θ Ξ p = None.
Proof.
  intros * H; unfold gc_module, gc_module_u, gc_resolve, gc_resolve_u in *; rewrite gs_find_tele_find.
  destruct (gs_find_tele Ξ p) as [[[U [| x ip]] T] |]; cbn; [ discriminate | eapply gm_submodule_resolve; exact H |].
  destruct (gds_lookup Θ (q_unit p)); [| discriminate ].
  destruct (q_chain p) as [| x ip]; cbn in *; [ destruct (gu_mod g); reflexivity || apply gm_resolve_nil | eapply gm_submodule_resolve; exact H ].
Qed.

The path of a member's module, open or filed, names no definition.
Lemma ind_mlookup_resolve : forall Θ Ξ p r,
    ind_mlookup Θ Ξ p = Some r -> gc_resolve Θ Ξ p = None.
Proof.
  intros * H; destruct (ind_mlookup_module _ _ _ _ H) as [[T Hm] | Hk]; [ exact (gc_module_resolve _ _ _ _ Hm) |].
  destruct (gs_find_ind_tele _ _ _ Hk) as (U & T & Ht).
  unfold gc_resolve, gc_resolve_u; rewrite gs_find_tele_find, Ht; cbn; apply gm_resolve_nil.
Qed.

What an Open Generates

open E use (n) declares n as a private definition equal to E.n, open E as y declares y a private alias of E, and, at the global level, an item naming a type former (an inductive or a record type), and open E as y of one, declares a definition with a module part of it; a local open of one is rejected. At the global level the generated entries are filed by the command (run_cmd_open); in a local body the open stays, and every reader of the body reads it as its generated entries (body_xp). The two share the generation relation items_gen, which reads the kind of each member off its member type.
What an item declares, read in the context of the open.
Inductive generated_item : Set :=
generated_item_def d pv A M: the definition d of type A equal to M
| generated_item_def : string -> bool -> typ -> exp -> generated_item
generated_item_alias d pv E: the alias d of E
| generated_item_alias : string -> bool -> modexp -> generated_item
generated_item_def_mod d pv A M E: the definition d of type A equal to M, with the module part the alias of E. A global open files it at its inferred type (gens_run_def_mod)
| generated_item_def_mod : string -> bool -> typ -> exp -> modexp -> generated_item.

A generated item as a body entry.
Definition generated_item_entry (g : generated_item) : (string * gentry)%type :=
  match g with
  | generated_item_def d pv A M => (d, ge_def true pv A (Some M))
  | generated_item_alias d pv E => (d, ge_mod pv (gu_mk nil (md_alias E)))
  | generated_item_def_mod d pv A M E => (d, ge_def_mod pv A M (gu_mk nil (md_alias E)))
  end.

Definition generated_item_name (g : generated_item) : string := fst (generated_item_entry g).

A generated item under a weakening and a substitution, as its entry is (generated_item_entry_wk, generated_item_entry_sub).
Definition generated_item_wk (g : generated_item) (φ : wk) : generated_item :=
  match g with
  | generated_item_def d pv A M => generated_item_def d pv A[φ]ʷ M[φ]ʷ
  | generated_item_alias d pv E => generated_item_alias d pv (modexp_wk E φ)
  | generated_item_def_mod d pv A M E => generated_item_def_mod d pv A[φ]ʷ M[φ]ʷ (modexp_wk E φ)
  end.

The substitution counterpart of generated_item_wk.
Definition generated_item_sub (g : generated_item) (σ : sub) : generated_item :=
  match g with
  | generated_item_def d pv A M => generated_item_def d pv A[σ] M[σ]
  | generated_item_alias d pv E => generated_item_alias d pv E[σ]ᵐ
  | generated_item_def_mod d pv A M E => generated_item_def_mod d pv A[σ] M[σ] E[σ]ᵐ
  end.

The generated entries appended to Φ, in order. All are read in the context of the open, so the k-th is weakened by the k before it.
Fixpoint gens_append (Φ : gmod) (k : nat) (gs : list generated_item) : gmod :=
  match gs with
  | nil => Φ
  | g :: gs' =>
      let '(d, E) := generated_item_entry g in
      gens_append (gm_ext Φ d (gentry_wk E (wk_shiftn k))) (S k) gs'
  end.

The first member named both by a private and by a public item.
Definition src_has (n : string) (pv : bool) (its : list iitem) : bool :=
  existsb (fun it => match it with
                     | (Some m, _, pv') => String.eqb n m && Bool.eqb pv pv'
                     | _ => false
                     end) its.

Definition both_dup (its : list iitem) : option string :=
  match find (fun it => match it with
                        | (Some n, _, pv) => src_has n (negb pv) its
                        | _ => false
                        end) its with
  | Some (Some n, _, _) => Some n
  | _ => None
  end.

The first name a list repeats.
Fixpoint name_dup (xs : list string) : option string :=
  match xs with
  | nil => None
  | x :: xs' => if existsb (String.eqb x) xs' then Some x else name_dup xs'
  end.

The open's own conditions on its items: no member both used and exported, and the declared names distinct.
Definition items_ok (its : list iitem) : Prop :=
  both_dup its = None /\ name_dup (List.map iitem_name its) = None.

A telescope of parameters has assumptions only: a module's arguments are terms. A unit has members only under such parameters.
Definition tele_ass (Δ : ctx) : Prop := List.Forall (fun e => exists A, e = ce_ass A) Δ.

Lemma tele_ass_wk : forall Δ φ, tele_ass Δ -> tele_ass (tele_wk Δ φ).
Proof.
  induction 1 as [| e Δ [A ->] HΔ IH]; cbn; constructor; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma tele_ass_sub : forall Δ σ, tele_ass Δ -> tele_ass (tele_sub Δ σ).
Proof.
  induction 1 as [| e Δ [A ->] HΔ IH]; cbn; constructor; eauto.
Qed.

What a Module Expression Denotes

mdenote Θ Ξ Γ H R, Γ ⊢ H ⇝ R: one rule per former. A loaded unit or an open frame denotes its stored closed unit, at its path, with no argument; a slot and a literal denote what their unit does; an application supplies the next parameter; and a selection finds the entry in the module part of the selected module's description and reads it there.
udenote Θ Ξ Γ o U R, Γ ⊢ U ⇓ R: what a module value denotes, o being the path it is stored at, if it is stored. A body, read through the entries its local opens generate (body_xp), by its storage (mdesc_body): a closed body only at its path; an alias, the module part of what its target denotes, abstracted over the alias's parameters. Aliases are resolved here only.
edenote Θ Ξ Γ o E R, Γ ⊢ E denotes R: what an entry stored at o denotes, one rule per entry kind. A definition is a term of its type, whose δ-reduct is its body when it is transparent; a module is what its unit denotes; an inductive or a record type is its type former with its module; a definition with a module part, its term with what its unit denotes as its module part.
Inductive mdenote (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) : ctx -> modexp -> mdesc -> Prop :=
A loaded unit or open frame: its stored closed unit, at its path
| mdenote_unit : forall Γ H p T Φ,
    mod_qname H = Some p ->
    gc_unit Θ Ξ H = Some (T, Φ) ->
    mdenote Θ Ξ Γ H (mdesc_closed nil p T Φ nil)
The open frame of the module of a member of a group of inductive types: the member's type former, as it is read once filed there (edenote_ind_case), of the declaration the frame carries, whose module part is the frame's body so far; the member is filed only when the frame closes, so it is denoted so nowhere else
| mdenote_ind_frame : forall Γ H p pq k D Mk Tm Φm,
    mod_qname H = Some p ->
    gs_find_ind Ξ p = Some (pq, k, D) ->
    ind_member D k = Some Mk ->
    gc_loc Θ Ξ p = Some (Tm, Φm) ->
    mdenote Θ Ξ Γ H (ind_former_desc pq k D Mk (mdesc_closed nil p Tm Φm nil))
A module slot: what its unit denotes
| mdenote_slot : forall Γ x U R,
    Γ ∋ #x ≔ₘ U ->
    udenote Θ Ξ Γ None U R ->
    mdenote Θ Ξ Γ (me_var x) R
A module literal: what its unit denotes
| mdenote_lit : forall Γ U R,
    udenote Θ Ξ Γ None U R ->
    mdenote Θ Ξ Γ (me_lit U) R
An application: the head's description given the next argument
| mdenote_app : forall Γ H N R R',
    mdenote Θ Ξ Γ H R ->
    mdesc_at R N = Some R' ->
    mdenote Θ Ξ Γ (me_app H N) R'
A selection: the entry found in the module part of the selected module's description, denoted and read there
| mdenote_mem : forall Γ H y R0 R0m Γy E rd R R',
    mdenote Θ Ξ Γ H R0 ->
    mdesc_mod R0 = Some R0m ->
    mdesc_entry R0m y = Some (Γy, E, rd) ->
    edenote Θ Ξ (Γy ++ Γ) (mdesc_entry_path R0m y) E R ->
    mdesc_read rd R = Some R' ->
    mdenote Θ Ξ Γ (me_mem H y) R'
The open frame of the module of a record type: the record's type former, as it is read once filed there (edenote_record), whose module part is the frame's body so far; the record is filed only when the frame closes, so it is denoted so nowhere else
| mdenote_record_frame : forall Γ H p R Tm Φm,
    mod_qname H = Some p ->
    gs_find_record Ξ p = Some R ->
    gc_loc Θ Ξ p = Some (Tm, Φm) ->
    mdenote Θ Ξ Γ H (record_former_desc p R (mdesc_closed nil p Tm Φm nil))
with udenote (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) : ctx -> option qname -> gunit -> mdesc -> Prop :=
A body, read through the entries its local opens generate, by its storage
| udenote_body : forall Γ o Δ sm Φ Φx R,
    body_xp Θ Ξ (Δ ++ Γ) Φ Φx ->
    mdesc_body o sm Δ Φ Φx = Some R ->
    udenote Θ Ξ Γ o (gu_mk Δ (md_body sm Φ)) R
An alias: the module part of what its target denotes, abstracted over the alias's parameters
| udenote_alias : forall Γ o Δ E R R',
    mdenote Θ Ξ (Δ ++ Γ) E R ->
    mdesc_mod R = Some R' ->
    udenote Θ Ξ Γ o (gu_mk Δ (md_alias E)) (mdesc_up Δ R')
with edenote (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) : ctx -> option qname -> gentry -> mdesc -> Prop :=
A definition: a term of its type, with its body as δ-reduct when it is transparent
| edenote_def : forall Γ o b pv A oM,
    edenote Θ Ξ Γ o (ge_def b pv A oM) (mdesc_term A (if b then oM else None))
A module: what its unit denotes
| edenote_mod : forall Γ o pv U R,
    udenote Θ Ξ Γ o U R ->
    edenote Θ Ξ Γ o (ge_mod pv U) R
An inductive member: its type former (ind_former_desc), whose module part is the member's module, stored at its path. The declaration is the one the entry stores, not one looked up again by path; the two agree in a well-formed context.
| edenote_ind_case : forall Γ o pv pq k D Φ Mk pm Tm Φm,
    ind_member D k = Some Mk ->
    ind_mpath D k = Some pm ->
    gc_loc Θ Ξ pm = Some (Tm, Φm) ->
    edenote Θ Ξ Γ o (ge_ind pv pq k D Φ) (ind_former_desc pq k D Mk (mdesc_closed nil pm Tm Φm nil))
A definition with a module part: its term, a transparent definition's, with what its unit, an alias, denotes as its module part. A module part that is no alias denotes nothing, as it is no module (gm_submodule).
| edenote_def_mod : forall Γ o pv A M Δ E Rm,
    udenote Θ Ξ Γ o (gu_mk Δ (md_alias E)) Rm ->
    edenote Θ Ξ Γ o (ge_def_mod pv A M (gu_mk Δ (md_alias E))) (mdesc_dm nil A M Rm)
A record type stored at p: its type former (record_former_desc), whose module part is its module, stored at p. It denotes only where it is stored, read at the path it is found at
| edenote_record : forall Γ p pv pr R Φ Tm Φm,
    gc_loc Θ Ξ p = Some (Tm, Φm) ->
    edenote Θ Ξ Γ (Some p) (ge_record pv pr R Φ) (record_former_desc p R (mdesc_closed nil p Tm Φm nil))
body_xp Θ Ξ Γ Φ Φx: the body Φ, read in Γ, is Φx with every local open replaced by the entries it generates (items_gen), in the context its own expanded prefix makes. The entries themselves are not looked into.
with body_xp (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) : ctx -> gmod -> gmod -> Prop :=
The empty body expands to itself
| body_xp_nil : forall Γ, body_xp Θ Ξ Γ gm_nil gm_nil
An entry is kept as it is
| body_xp_ext : forall Γ Φ Φx x E,
    body_xp Θ Ξ Γ Φ Φx ->
    body_xp Θ Ξ Γ (gm_ext Φ x E) (gm_ext Φx x E)
A local open of a module is replaced by the entries its items generate
| body_xp_open : forall Γ Φ Φx H its R Rm gs,
    body_xp Θ Ξ Γ Φ Φx ->
    mdenote Θ Ξ (body_ctx Φx ++ Γ) H R ->
    mdesc_mod R = Some Rm ->
    items_gen Θ Ξ (body_ctx Φx ++ Γ) H its gs ->
    items_ok its ->
    body_xp Θ Ξ Γ (gm_open Φ H its) (gens_append Φx 0 gs)
items_gen Θ Ξ Γ H its gs: what the items its of an open of H declare, all read in Γ, by what the member each names denotes: a term gives a definition of its type, a module an alias, and a member with both a term part and a module part a definition with a module part; an item naming no member, the alias of H itself, whatever H is. A global open and a local one generate alike.
with items_gen (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) : ctx -> modexp -> list iitem -> list generated_item -> Prop :=
No item generates nothing
| items_gen_nil : forall Γ H, items_gen Θ Ξ Γ H nil nil
An item naming no member (open E as y): the alias of H itself, whatever H is
| items_gen_self : forall Γ H d pv its gs,
    items_gen Θ Ξ Γ H its gs ->
    items_gen Θ Ξ Γ H ((None, d, pv) :: its) (generated_item_alias d pv H :: gs)
An item naming a term: a definition of its type, by selection
| items_gen_def : forall Γ H n d pv A om its gs,
    mdenote Θ Ξ Γ (me_mem H n) (mdesc_term A om) ->
    items_gen Θ Ξ Γ H its gs ->
    items_gen Θ Ξ Γ H ((Some n, d, pv) :: its) (generated_item_def d pv A (a_mem H n) :: gs)
An item naming a module: an alias of the selection
| items_gen_mod : forall Γ H n d pv R its gs,
    mdenote Θ Ξ Γ (me_mem H n) R ->
    mdesc_is_mod R ->
    items_gen Θ Ξ Γ H its gs ->
    items_gen Θ Ξ Γ H ((Some n, d, pv) :: its) (generated_item_alias d pv (me_mem H n) :: gs)
An item naming a member with both a term part and a module part (a type former, or a definition with a module part): a definition with a module part of the term part's type, the selection as its term and the alias of the selection as its module
| items_gen_dm : forall Γ H n d pv R A Rm its gs,
    mdenote Θ Ξ Γ (me_mem H n) R ->
    mdesc_type R = Some A ->
    mdesc_mod R = Some Rm ->
    items_gen Θ Ξ Γ H its gs ->
    items_gen Θ Ξ Γ H ((Some n, d, pv) :: its) (generated_item_def_mod d pv A (a_mem H n) (me_mem H n) :: gs).

Scheme mdenote_mut_ind := Induction for mdenote Sort Prop
with udenote_mut_ind := Induction for udenote Sort Prop
with edenote_mut_ind := Induction for edenote Sort Prop
with body_xp_mut_ind := Induction for body_xp Sort Prop
with items_gen_mut_ind := Induction for items_gen Sort Prop.
Combined Scheme mdenote_all_ind from mdenote_mut_ind, udenote_mut_ind, edenote_mut_ind, body_xp_mut_ind, items_gen_mut_ind.

#[export]
Hint Constructors mdenote udenote edenote body_xp items_gen : mctt.

open_gens Θ Ξ Γ H its gs: an open of H with items its, in Γ: H is a module, and gs is what the items declare. (Its witnesses are informative, so they have no projections.)
#[warnings="-cannot-define-projection"]
Record open_gens (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (Γ : ctx) (H : modexp) (its : list iitem) (gs : list generated_item) : Prop :=
  mk_open_gens
  { open_gens_desc : mdesc
  ; open_gens_mod : mdesc
  ; open_gens_denote : mdenote Θ Ξ Γ H open_gens_desc
  ; open_gens_is_mod : mdesc_mod open_gens_desc = Some open_gens_mod
  ; open_gens_items : items_gen Θ Ξ Γ H its gs
  ; open_gens_ok : items_ok its }.

A unit with its body expanded; an alias is its own.
Inductive unit_xp (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (Γ : ctx) : gunit -> gunit -> Prop :=
| unit_xp_body : forall Δ sm Φ Φx, body_xp Θ Ξ (Δ ++ Γ) Φ Φx -> unit_xp Θ Ξ Γ (gu_mk Δ (md_body sm Φ)) (gu_mk Δ (md_body sm Φx))
| unit_xp_alias : forall Δ E, unit_xp Θ Ξ Γ (gu_mk Δ (md_alias E)) (gu_mk Δ (md_alias E)).

#[export]
Hint Constructors unit_xp : mctt.

The targets of the local opens of Φ, newest first, each with the context its expanded prefix makes, where Φx is the expansion of Φ.
Fixpoint gm_dropn (n : nat) (Φ : gmod) : gmod :=
  match n, Φ with
  | 0, _ => Φ
  | S n', gm_ext Φ' _ _ => gm_dropn n' Φ'
  | S _, _ => Φ
  end.

Fixpoint body_opens (Φ Φx : gmod) : list (ctx * modexp) :=
  match Φ with
  | gm_nil => nil
  | gm_ext Φ0 _ _ => body_opens Φ0 (gm_dropn 1 Φx)
  | gm_open Φ0 H its =>
      let Φ0x := gm_dropn (List.length its) Φx in
      (body_ctx Φ0x, H) :: body_opens Φ0 Φ0x
  end.

The same, each target with the expanded prefix itself.
Fixpoint body_opens_at (Φ Φx : gmod) : list (gmod * modexp) :=
  match Φ with
  | gm_nil => nil
  | gm_ext Φ0 _ _ => body_opens_at Φ0 (gm_dropn 1 Φx)
  | gm_open Φ0 H its =>
      let Φ0x := gm_dropn (List.length its) Φx in
      (Φ0x, H) :: body_opens_at Φ0 Φ0x
  end.

Lemma body_opens_at_nth : forall Φ Φx k Φ0 H,
    nth_error (body_opens_at Φ Φx) k = Some (Φ0, H) -> nth_error (body_opens Φ Φx) k = Some (body_ctx Φ0, H).
Proof.
  induction Φ as [| Φ IH x E | Φ IH H0 its]; intros * Hk; cbn in *; [ destruct k; discriminate | eauto |].
  destruct k as [| k]; cbn in *; [ injection Hk as <- <-; reflexivity | eauto ].
Qed.

Lemma body_opens_nth_at : forall Φ Φx k Ψ H,
    nth_error (body_opens Φ Φx) k = Some (Ψ, H) -> exists Φ0, nth_error (body_opens_at Φ Φx) k = Some (Φ0, H) /\ Ψ = body_ctx Φ0.
Proof.
  induction Φ as [| Φ IH x E | Φ IH H0 its]; intros * Hk; cbn in *; [ destruct k; discriminate | eauto |].
  destruct k as [| k]; cbn in *; [ injection Hk as <- <-; eauto | eauto ].
Qed.

The number of local opens of a body.
Fixpoint gm_nopens (Φ : gmod) : nat :=
  match Φ with
  | gm_nil => 0
  | gm_ext Φ0 _ _ => gm_nopens Φ0
  | gm_open Φ0 _ _ => S (gm_nopens Φ0)
  end.

The Shape of an Expansion


Lemma items_gen_length : forall Θ Ξ Γ H its gs, items_gen Θ Ξ Γ H its gs -> List.length gs = List.length its.
Proof. induction 1; cbn; auto. Qed.

Lemma items_gen_names : forall Θ Ξ Γ H its gs, items_gen Θ Ξ Γ H its gs -> List.map generated_item_name gs = List.map iitem_name its.
Proof. induction 1; cbn; f_equal; auto. Qed.

The context an open's entries make, over the body before it.
Lemma gens_body_ctx_base : forall gs Φ k,
    body_ctx (gens_append Φ k gs) = body_ctx (gens_append gm_nil k gs) ++ body_ctx Φ.
Proof.
  induction gs as [| g gs IH]; intros; cbn [gens_append]; [ reflexivity |].
  destruct (generated_item_entry g) as [d E].
  rewrite IH, (IH (gm_ext gm_nil d _)), <- List.app_assoc.
  destruct E as [? ? ? [] | | | |]; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma gens_append_binders : forall gs Φ k, gm_binders (gens_append Φ k gs) = List.length gs + gm_binders Φ.
Proof.
  induction gs as [| g gs IH]; intros; cbn; [ reflexivity |].
  destruct (generated_item_entry g) eqn:E; rewrite IH; cbn; lia.
Qed.

Lemma gm_dropn_add : forall a b Φ, gm_dropn (a + b) Φ = gm_dropn b (gm_dropn a Φ).
Proof.
  induction a as [| a IH]; intros b [| Φ x E | Φ H its]; cbn; auto; destruct b; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma gm_dropn_gens_append : forall gs Φ k, gm_dropn (List.length gs) (gens_append Φ k gs) = Φ.
Proof.
  induction gs as [| g gs IH]; intros; cbn [gens_append List.length]; [ destruct Φ; reflexivity |].
  destruct (generated_item_entry g) eqn:E.
  replace (S (List.length gs)) with (List.length gs + 1) by lia; rewrite gm_dropn_add, IH; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma body_xp_binders : forall Θ Ξ Γ Φ Φx, body_xp Θ Ξ Γ Φ Φx -> gm_binders Φx = gm_binders Φ.
Proof.
  induction 1; cbn; auto.
  rewrite gens_append_binders; erewrite items_gen_length by eassumption; lia.
Qed.

Lemma gens_append_nopens : forall gs Φ k, gm_nopens (gens_append Φ k gs) = gm_nopens Φ.
Proof. induction gs as [| g gs IH]; intros; cbn; [ reflexivity |]; destruct (generated_item_entry g); rewrite IH; reflexivity. Qed.

An expansion has no open.
Lemma body_xp_nopens : forall Θ Ξ Γ Φ Φx, body_xp Θ Ξ Γ Φ Φx -> gm_nopens Φx = 0.
Proof. induction 1; cbn; auto; rewrite gens_append_nopens; assumption. Qed.

Lemma body_opens_length : forall Θ Ξ Γ Φ Φx, body_xp Θ Ξ Γ Φ Φx -> List.length (body_opens Φ Φx) = gm_nopens Φ.
Proof.
  induction 1; cbn; auto.
  erewrite <- items_gen_length by eassumption; rewrite gm_dropn_gens_append; f_equal; assumption.
Qed.

The opens of a body after an entry, or after an open, are those of the body before it, and that open.
Lemma body_opens_ext : forall Φ Φx x E y E', body_opens (gm_ext Φ x E) (gm_ext Φx y E') = body_opens Φ Φx.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma body_opens_open_len : forall Φ Φx H its gs, List.length gs = List.length its ->
    body_opens (gm_open Φ H its) (gens_append Φx 0 gs) = (body_ctx Φx, H) :: body_opens Φ Φx.
Proof. intros * Hl; cbn; rewrite <- Hl, gm_dropn_gens_append; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma body_opens_open : forall Θ Ξ Γ Φ Φx H its gs,
    items_gen Θ Ξ Γ H its gs ->
    body_opens (gm_open Φ H its) (gens_append Φx 0 gs) = (body_ctx Φx, H) :: body_opens Φ Φx.
Proof.
  intros * Hg; cbn; erewrite <- items_gen_length by eassumption; rewrite gm_dropn_gens_append; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma body_opens_at_open_len : forall Φ Φx H its gs, List.length gs = List.length its ->
    body_opens_at (gm_open Φ H its) (gens_append Φx 0 gs) = (Φx, H) :: body_opens_at Φ Φx.
Proof. intros * Hl; cbn; rewrite <- Hl, gm_dropn_gens_append; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma body_opens_at_open : forall Θ Ξ Γ Φ Φx H its gs,
    items_gen Θ Ξ Γ H its gs ->
    body_opens_at (gm_open Φ H its) (gens_append Φx 0 gs) = (Φx, H) :: body_opens_at Φ Φx.
Proof.
  intros * Hg; cbn; erewrite <- items_gen_length by eassumption; rewrite gm_dropn_gens_append; reflexivity.
Qed.

The expansion of the body before the open that declares x, read off the body Φ and its expansion Φx.
Fixpoint gm_item_xp (Φ Φx : gmod) (x : string) : gmod :=
  match Φ, Φx with
  | gm_ext Φ' _ _, gm_ext Φx' _ _ => gm_item_xp Φ' Φx' x
  | gm_open Φ' _ its, _ =>
      match items_upto x its with
      | Some _ => gm_dropn (List.length its) Φx
      | None => gm_item_xp Φ' (gm_dropn (List.length its) Φx) x
      end
  | _, _ => gm_nil
  end.

Lemma body_xp_item : forall Θ Ξ Γ Φ Φx, body_xp Θ Ξ Γ Φ Φx ->
    forall x Φ0 H its1 it, gm_item_upto Φ x = Some (Φ0, H, its1, it) -> body_xp Θ Ξ Γ Φ0 (gm_item_xp Φ Φx x).
Proof.
  induction 1 as [Γ | Γ Φ Φx y E Hx IH | Γ Φ Φx H its R T gs Hx IH HR HT Hg Hok]; intros x Φ0 H0 its1 it Hi;
    cbn [gm_item_upto gm_item_xp] in *; try discriminate.
  - destruct (String.eqb x y); [ discriminate | eauto ].
  - rewrite <- (items_gen_length _ _ _ _ _ _ Hg), gm_dropn_gens_append.
    destruct (items_upto x its) as [[its1' it'] |]; [ injection Hi as <- <- <- <-; exact Hx | eauto ].
Qed.

The Module that Declares a Member

msite Θ Ξ H q: the module expression H, reached from a unit, is the module stored at q, read step by step: a loaded unit or an open frame is stored at its own path, a body module (or the module of an inductive type) at its entry's path, an alias (or the module view of an inductive alias) where its target is, and arguments change nothing. mdecl Θ Ξ H y q pv: the member y of H is the entry y of the module stored at q, with privacy pv.
The body an entry stores, as a module.
Definition entry_is_body (E : gentry) : Prop :=
  match E with
  | ge_mod _ (gu_mk _ (md_body _ _)) | ge_ind _ _ _ _ _ | ge_record _ _ _ _ => True
  | _ => False
  end.

The target of an alias entry, as a module: that of a definition with a module part's alias.
Definition entry_alias (E : gentry) : option modexp :=
  match E with
  | ge_mod _ (gu_mk _ (md_alias E')) => Some E'
  | ge_def_mod _ _ _ (gu_mk _ (md_alias E')) => Some E'
  | _ => None
  end.

Inductive msite (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) : modexp -> qname -> Prop :=
A loaded unit or an open frame
| ms_unit : forall H p T Φ,
    mod_qname H = Some p ->
    gc_unit Θ Ξ H = Some (T, Φ) ->
    msite Θ Ξ H p
The open frame of the module of a member of a group
| ms_ind_frame : forall H p r,
    mod_qname H = Some p ->
    gs_find_ind Ξ p = Some r ->
    msite Θ Ξ H p
A body module, at its entry
| ms_body : forall H pq z E,
    msite Θ Ξ H pq ->
    gc_entry Θ Ξ (qname_in pq z) = Some E ->
    entry_is_body E ->
    msite Θ Ξ (me_mem H z) (qname_in pq z)
An alias, where its target is
| ms_alias : forall H pq z E E' pq',
    msite Θ Ξ H pq ->
    gc_entry Θ Ξ (qname_in pq z) = Some E ->
    entry_alias E = Some E' ->
    msite Θ Ξ E' pq' ->
    msite Θ Ξ (me_mem H z) pq'
An application, where its module is
| ms_app : forall H N pq,
    msite Θ Ξ H pq ->
    msite Θ Ξ (me_app H N) pq
The open frame of the module of a record type
| ms_record_frame : forall H p R,
    mod_qname H = Some p ->
    gs_find_record Ξ p = Some R ->
    msite Θ Ξ H p.

Inductive mdecl (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (H : modexp) (y : string) : qname -> bool -> Prop :=
| mdecl_intro : forall pq E,
    msite Θ Ξ H pq ->
    gc_entry Θ Ξ (qname_in pq y) = Some E ->
    mdecl Θ Ξ H y pq (ge_private E).

#[export]
Hint Constructors msite mdecl : mctt.

Stored Modules and Entries

A unit is a filed module at arguments, P N⃗ (a loaded unit, an open frame, or a body module stored at its path, given arguments), or a literal (U).

Lemma gm_subbody_module : forall Φ T x ip T' Φ',
    gm_subbody T Φ x ip = Some (T', Φ') -> exists oD, gm_submodule T Φ x ip = Some (mr_body T' oD).
Proof.
  fix IH 1; intros [| Φ y E | Φ c] * H; cbn in H |- *; [ discriminate | | exact (IH _ _ _ _ _ _ H) ].
  destruct (String.eqb x y); [| exact (IH _ _ _ _ _ _ H) ].
  destruct E as [? ? ? ? | ? [Δ [? Φ0 | E0]] | ? ? ? D0 Φ0 | ? Aa Ma [Δa [? Φa | Ea]] | ? Rr Φ0]; try discriminate;
    destruct ip as [| z ip]; first [ injection H as <- <-; eexists; reflexivity | exact (IH _ _ _ _ _ _ H) ].
Qed.

Lemma gc_body_module : forall Θ Ξ p T Φ, gc_body Θ Ξ p = Some (T, Φ) -> exists oD, gc_module Θ Ξ p = Some (mr_body T oD).
Proof.
  intros * H; unfold gc_body, gc_module, gc_module_u in *.
  destruct (gs_find_tele Ξ p) as [[[U [| x ip]] T0] |]; [ discriminate | exact (gm_subbody_module _ _ _ _ _ _ H) |].
  destruct (gds_lookup Θ (q_unit p)) as [U |]; [| discriminate ].
  destruct (q_chain p) as [| x ip]; cbn in H |- *; [ injection H as <- <-; eexists; reflexivity | exact (gm_subbody_module _ _ _ _ _ _ H) ].
Qed.

What gc_loc finds is no alias.
Lemma gc_loc_not_alias : forall Θ Ξ p TΦ U, gc_loc Θ Ξ p = Some TΦ -> gc_module Θ Ξ p = Some (mr_alias U) -> False.
Proof.
  intros * Hl Hm; unfold gc_loc in Hl; destruct (gc_frame Ξ p) as [r |] eqn:Hf.
  - unfold gc_frame, gc_module, gc_module_u in *.
    destruct (gs_find_tele Ξ p) as [[[[Δ [[|] Φ0 | E]] [| x ip]] T0] |]; discriminate.
  - destruct TΦ as [T Φ]; destruct (gc_body_module _ _ _ _ _ Hl) as (oD & Hm'); rewrite Hm in Hm'; discriminate.
Qed.

An entry a path resolves to is the entry stored there.
Lemma gm_resolve_entry : forall ip Φ E, gm_resolve Φ ip = Some E -> gm_entry Φ ip = Some E.
Proof.
  induction ip as [| x ip IH]; intros Φ; induction Φ as [| Φ IHΦ y E0 | Φ IHΦ H its]; intros E Hr; cbn in *;
    try discriminate; try (apply IHΦ; exact Hr).
  destruct (String.eqb x y); [| apply IHΦ; exact Hr ].
  destruct ip as [| x' ip'];
    destruct E0 as [b pv A B | pv [Δ [sm Φ' | E']] | pv pq k D Φ' | pv A M U | pv pr R Φ'];
    try discriminate; try exact Hr; apply IH; exact Hr.
Qed.

Lemma gc_resolve_entry : forall Θ Ξ p E, gc_resolve Θ Ξ p = Some E -> gc_entry Θ Ξ p = Some E.
Proof.
  intros * Hr; unfold gc_resolve, gc_resolve_u, gc_entry, gc_entry_u in *.
  destruct (gs_find Ξ p) as [[U ip] |]; [ exact (gm_resolve_entry _ _ _ Hr) |].
  destruct (gds_lookup Θ (q_unit p)); [ exact (gm_resolve_entry _ _ _ Hr) | discriminate ].
Qed.

A path resolving to a definition names no member with a term part and a module part.
Lemma gc_resolve_def_not_dm : forall Θ Ξ p b pv A B, gc_resolve Θ Ξ p = Some (ge_def b pv A B) -> ~ dm_path Θ Ξ p.
Proof.
  intros * Hr [(r & Hi) | [(R & Hl) | (pv' & A' & M' & U & He)]].
  - destruct (ind_mlookup_module _ _ _ _ Hi) as [(T & Hm) | Hf].
    + rewrite (gc_module_resolve _ _ _ _ Hm) in Hr; discriminate.
    + destruct (gs_find_ind_tele _ _ _ Hf) as (U & T & Ht).
      unfold gc_resolve, gc_resolve_u in Hr; rewrite gs_find_tele_find, Ht in Hr; cbn in Hr.
      rewrite gm_resolve_nil in Hr; discriminate.
  - unfold record_lookup in Hl; destruct (gs_find_record Ξ p) as [R0 |] eqn:Hf.
    + destruct (gs_find_record_tele _ _ _ Hf) as (U & T & Ht).
      unfold gc_resolve, gc_resolve_u in Hr; rewrite gs_find_tele_find, Ht in Hr; cbn in Hr.
      rewrite gm_resolve_nil in Hr; discriminate.
    + rewrite (gc_resolve_entry _ _ _ _ Hr) in Hl; discriminate.
  - rewrite (gc_resolve_entry _ _ _ _ Hr) in He; discriminate.
Qed.

The term part a path is selected as: the body of a transparent definition it resolves to, or the term of a definition with a module part stored there, which resolves to nothing.
Lemma gc_term_inv : forall Θ Ξ p M, gc_term Θ Ξ p = Some M ->
    (exists pv A, gc_resolve Θ Ξ p = Some (ge_def true pv A (Some M))) \/
    (exists pv A U, gc_entry Θ Ξ p = Some (ge_def_mod pv A M U)).
Proof.
  intros * Ht; unfold gc_term in Ht.
  destruct (gc_resolve Θ Ξ p) as [E |] eqn:Er.
  - destruct E as [[] pv A [M' |] | | | |];
      try (injection Ht as <-; left; eauto; fail);
      rewrite (gc_resolve_entry _ _ _ _ Er) in Ht; cbn in Ht;
      first [ discriminate | injection Ht as <-; right; do 3 eexists; exact (gc_resolve_entry _ _ _ _ Er) ].
  - destruct (gc_entry Θ Ξ p) as [[| | | pv A M' U |] |]; try discriminate.
    injection Ht as <-; right; eauto.
Qed.

A path resolving to a transparent definition is selected as its body.
Lemma gc_term_of_resolve : forall Θ Ξ p pv A M,
    gc_resolve Θ Ξ p = Some (ge_def true pv A (Some M)) -> gc_term Θ Ξ p = Some M.
Proof. intros * Hr; unfold gc_term; rewrite Hr; reflexivity. Qed.

A path storing a definition with a module part is selected as its term.
Lemma gc_term_of_def_mod : forall Θ Ξ p pv A M U,
    gc_entry Θ Ξ p = Some (ge_def_mod pv A M U) -> gc_term Θ Ξ p = Some M.
Proof.
  intros * He; unfold gc_term.
  destruct (gc_resolve Θ Ξ p) as [E |] eqn:Hr; [| rewrite He; reflexivity ].
  destruct E as [[|] pv' A' [M' |] | | | |]; try (rewrite He; reflexivity).
  exfalso; apply (gc_resolve_def_not_dm _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hr); right; right; do 4 eexists; exact He.
Qed.

What a term entry stored at o describes as a term: a definition; a type former, the term part of its ind_former_desc or record_former_desc; a definition with a module part, its term part, read as a transparent definition is. A record entry stores no path, so it describes its type former only where it is stored.
Definition entry_term (o : option qname) (E : gentry) : option mdesc :=
  match E with
  | ge_def b _ A oM => Some (mdesc_term A (if b then oM else None))
  | ge_ind _ pq k D _ =>
      option_map (fun Mk => mdesc_term (ctx_pi (im_params D Mk) (exp_wk (ind_sort D) (wk_shiftn (im_nn Mk)))) (Some (a_ind pq k)))
        (ind_member D k)
  | ge_def_mod _ A M _ => Some (mdesc_term A (Some M))
  | ge_mod _ _ => None
  | ge_record _ _ R _ => option_map (fun p => mdesc_term (ctx_pi (record_params R) (record_sort R)) (Some (a_record p))) o
  end.

A stored alias entry as the alias unit it is, over its full telescope: a definition with a module part as its module part.
Definition entry_alias_unit (E : gentry) : option gunit :=
  match E with
  | ge_mod _ (gu_mk Ta (md_alias E')) => Some (gu_mk Ta (md_alias E'))
  | ge_def_mod _ _ _ (gu_mk Ta (md_alias E')) => Some (gu_mk Ta (md_alias E'))
  | _ => None
  end.

A unit of the context after a body's parameters, abstracted over them.
Definition gunit_abs (Δ : ctx) (U : gunit) : gunit :=
  match U with
  | gu_mk Δy D => gu_mk (Δy ++ Δ) D
  end.
